segments.GAL.1.1-2: Paul writes to the churches of Galatia
segments.GAL.1.3-5: Christ gave himself for our sins to rescue us
segments.GAL.1.6-7: Paul is amazed that the Galatians turn to another gospel
segments.GAL.1.8-9: Anyone who preaches a different gospel is under a curse
segments.GAL.1.10-10: Paul wants to please God, not people
segments.GAL.1.11-12: Paul received the gospel from Jesus Christ, not from men
segments.GAL.1.13-14: Paul once persecuted the church of God
segments.GAL.1.15-17: God called Paul to preach to the Gentiles
segments.GAL.1.18-20: Paul visits Cephas in Jerusalem for fifteen days
segments.GAL.1.21-24: The churches of Judea praise God because of Paul
segments.GAL.2.1-2: Paul goes to Jerusalem and tells the leaders the gospel
segments.GAL.2.3-5: Titus is not forced to be circumcised
segments.GAL.2.6-8: The leaders accept Paul’s work among the Gentiles
segments.GAL.2.9-10: James, Cephas and John welcome Paul and Barnabas
segments.GAL.2.11-12: Paul opposes Cephas for avoiding Gentile believers
segments.GAL.2.13-14: Paul corrects Cephas in front of everyone
segments.GAL.2.15-16: People are made right by faith in Christ, not by the law
segments.GAL.2.17-19: Paul says Christ does not make believers sinners
segments.GAL.2.20-21: Paul lives by faith in the Son of God who loved him
segments.GAL.3.1-3: Paul asks the Galatians if the law brought the Spirit
segments.GAL.3.4-5: Paul asks if God works miracles by law or by faith
segments.GAL.3.6-9: Those who have faith are sons of Abraham
segments.GAL.3.10-12: The law brings a curse; the righteous live by faith
segments.GAL.3.13-14: Christ freed us from the curse of the law
segments.GAL.3.17-18: The law does not cancel God’s promise to Abraham
segments.GAL.3.19-20: Paul explains why God gave the law
segments.GAL.3.21-22: The law does not oppose God’s promises
segments.GAL.3.23-25: The law was a guardian until faith came
segments.GAL.3.26-26: All believers are sons of God through faith
segments.GAL.3.27-29: All believers are one in Christ and heirs of Abraham
segments.GAL.4.1-2: An heir who is a child is like a slave
segments.GAL.4.3-5: God sent his Son to redeem people under the law
segments.GAL.4.8-9: Paul asks why the Galatians want to be slaves again
segments.GAL.4.10-11: Paul fears for the Galatians who keep special days
segments.GAL.4.12-14: The Galatians welcomed Paul like an angel of God
segments.GAL.4.15-16: Paul asks if the truth made him the Galatians’ enemy
segments.GAL.4.17-18: False teachers want to separate the Galatians from Paul
segments.GAL.4.19-20: Paul longs to be with the Galatians, his children
segments.GAL.4.21-23: Abraham had two sons, by a slave woman and a free woman
segments.GAL.4.24-25: Hagar stands for the covenant of Mount Sinai and slavery
segments.GAL.4.26-27: The Jerusalem above is free and is our mother
segments.GAL.4.28-29: Believers are children of promise, like Isaac
segments.GAL.4.30-31: Believers are children of the free woman, not the slave
segments.GAL.5.1-2: Paul urges believers to stand firm in freedom
segments.GAL.5.3-4: Men who are circumcised must obey the whole law
segments.GAL.5.5-8: Faith working through love matters, not circumcision
segments.GAL.5.9-10: Whoever troubles the Galatians will bear judgment
segments.GAL.5.11-12: Paul is persecuted because he does not preach circumcision
segments.GAL.5.13-15: Believers should use freedom to serve one another in love
segments.GAL.5.16-18: Believers should walk by the Spirit, not the flesh
segments.GAL.5.19-21: Paul lists the acts of the flesh and warns believers
segments.GAL.5.25-26: Believers should walk with the Spirit and not be proud
segments.GAL.6.1-2: Believers should gently restore someone caught in sin
segments.GAL.6.3-5: Each believer should test his own work and carry his load
segments.GAL.6.6-8: A person reaps what he sows, from flesh or Spirit
segments.GAL.6.9-10: Believers should not grow tired of doing good to all
segments.GAL.6.11-13: Some people force circumcision to avoid persecution
segments.GAL.6.14-16: Paul boasts only in the cross; a new creation counts
segments.GAL.6.17-18: Paul bears Jesus’ marks and blesses the believers
